pending.title: Christmas Coloring Book Gift for Animal Lovers | Cathedral Creatures
pending.alt: Cathedral Creatures stained glass animal coloring book with a golden lion window on the cover, on a wooden table with ribbon, pine and colored pencils
pending.text: A Christmas gift for animal lovers who color. Cathedral Creatures holds 40 stained-glass animal designs: the Lion of Judah, the Pelican in Her Piety, foxes in the vineyard, bees and honeycomb, the peaceable kingdom. Each plate is named and paired with Scripture or medieval tradition. Single-sided 8.5 x 11 pages for colored pencils, markers and gel pens. Paperback on Amazon.

pending.title: Inside Sacred Glass: 40 Stained Glass Cross Coloring Pages

pending.text: See inside Sacred Glass: a cardinal in the snow, a hedgehog among the holly, a chickadee in the pine and the empty cross at dawn. 40 stained-glass crosses, Celtic, Coptic, Fleury and more, each paired with a King James verse and arranged through the seasons. Large single-sided pages made for adult coloring with pencils or gel pens. Paperback on Amazon.

pending.title: Christian Coloring Book Gift for Women | Sacred Glass
pending.alt: Sacred Glass coloring book with a jeweled stained glass cross, lilies and roses on the cover, on dark velvet with gold ribbon
pending.text: A thoughtful Christmas gift for a woman of faith. Sacred Glass gathers 40 stained-glass crosses to color, Celtic, Coptic, Jerusalem, Fleury and more, set among lilies, roses, songbirds and winter pine. Each section opens with Scripture (KJV) and a short reflection page. Single-sided 8.5 x 11 pages. Paperback on Amazon.

pending.text: Peek inside Cathedral Creatures: turtledoves in the fig tree, the butterfly of new life, hares in a Celtic vine and the cow and bear of the peaceable kingdom. 40 stained-glass animal windows inspired by Scripture and the medieval bestiary, from open and restful to intricate. pending.title: Stained Glass Coloring Book Gift | Church Windows
pending.alt: Church Windows coloring book with a stained glass sacred heart, roses and lilies on the cover, on cream linen with colored pencils
pending.text: Forty windows of light to color. Church Windows holds 40 original stained-glass church window designs, from simple and serene to beautifully intricate: sacred hearts, doves, lilies, anchors and trees of life, in five themed sections with Scripture and reflection. Large single-sided 8.5 x 11 pages. A gift for the women you love, or a quiet hour for yourself. Paperback on Amazon.
